checklist.airDrop.help: AirDrop shares the Wi-Fi radio and pauses it to look for nearby devices.
checklist.airDrop.title: AirDrop set to No One
checklist.browserEnergySaver.help: In Chrome: Settings → Performance → Energy Saver. It lowers the frame rate.
checklist.browserEnergySaver.title: Browser energy saver off
checklist.controllerUSB.help: Less input delay than Bluetooth, and Bluetooth shares the Wi-Fi radio.
checklist.controllerUSB.title: Controller on a USB cable
checklist.handoff.help: Handoff uses the same radio as AirDrop.
checklist.handoff.title: Handoff off
checklist.locationServices.help: Location makes the Wi-Fi scan for networks, which pauses it. Or switch off just System Services → Networking & Wireless.
checklist.locationServices.title: Location Services off while gaming
checklist.streamIPv6.help: If your provider uses carrier-grade NAT, IPv6 skips it.
checklist.streamIPv6.title: Prefer IPv6 if offered
checklist.streamQuality.help: In the game service's settings: the highest resolution and bitrate your line allows.
checklist.streamQuality.title: Stream quality set to the highest
checklist.universalControl.help: It keeps the AirDrop radio busy too.
checklist.universalControl.title: Universal Control off
finding.appsNoisy: Some apps can disturb the stream. Game Mode quits them.
finding.appsQuiet: No background apps that get in the way.
finding.awdlOn: AirDrop and Handoff are on. They pause the Wi-Fi now and then. Game Mode switches them off.
finding.batteryLow: The battery is getting low. Plug in.
finding.checklistDone: Every item on the checklist is done.
finding.checklistOpen: A few settings on the checklist are still open.
finding.cpuBusy: Your Mac is busy with something else.
finding.ethernet: Wired with a cable. The steadiest way to play.
finding.hopLoss: Packets are getting lost between your Mac and the router.
finding.hopPausing: Your Mac's Wi-Fi keeps pausing. Turn on Game Mode, or plug in a cable.
finding.hopSpiky: Your Mac's Wi-Fi has small pauses. Game Mode usually fixes this.
finding.hopSteady: Your Mac's link to the router is steady.
finding.internetLoss: Packets are getting lost on the internet side.
finding.internetPoor: Latency is high or jumping around. Expect lag.
finding.internetSlowish: Latency is a little high or uneven.
finding.ipv6Missing: No IPv6. Not a problem, just one route fewer.
finding.ipv6Ready: IPv6 works, so games can use the more direct route.
finding.lineBusy: Something else is using the line right now. Downloads and updates cause lag.
finding.lineMaybeBusy: Someone else may be using the line.
finding.lineQuiet: Nothing else seems to be using the line.
finding.lowPowerOn: Low Power Mode is on. It slows the Mac down.
finding.macReady: Ready: on power, cool and not busy.
finding.onBattery: Running on battery. Plug in for steadier performance.
finding.speedBloatBad: Latency jumps when the line is busy. Turn on Smart Queues (SQM) on the router.
finding.speedBloatMild: Latency rises when the line is busy. Smart Queues (SQM) on the router helps.
finding.speedGood: Plenty of speed, and latency stays low under load.
finding.speedRateLimited: The speed test server asked us to wait. Try again in a few minutes.
finding.speedSlow: Speed is on the low side for high quality.
finding.speedTooSlow: Too slow for smooth streaming. Lower the stream quality.
finding.thermalHigh: Your Mac is hot and may slow down.
finding.timeMachineRunning: A Time Machine backup is running. Game Mode pauses it.
finding.udpClean: Game traffic gets through without loss.
finding.udpLossy: Game traffic is getting lost. Expect stutter.
finding.udpSlow: Game traffic is slow to come back.
finding.udpSomeLoss: A little game traffic is getting lost.
finding.wifi24GHz: Wi-Fi on 2.4 GHz, which is crowded and slow. Join the 5 or 6 GHz network, or plug in a cable.
finding.wifi5GHz: Wi-Fi on 5 GHz. Fine, though a cable is steadier.
finding.wifi6GHz: Wi-Fi on 6 GHz. Good, though a cable is steadier.
finding.wifiPoor: The signal is weak. Move closer to the router or use a cable.
finding.wifiStrong: Strong signal and a fast link.
finding.wifiWeak: The signal is a little weak. Moving closer to the router helps.
ui.changes.cannotRead: Couldn't read the current %@ setting, so nothing was changed.
ui.changes.cannotSave: Couldn't save the undo plan, so nothing was changed.
ui.changes.unreadablePlan: The undo plan from an earlier session can't be read, so nothing was changed. It's kept in Application Support/Game Ready/restore-plan.json.
ui.gameMode.help: Switches off AirDrop, Handoff and Universal Control, keeps the Mac awake, pauses Time Machine and quits apps that get in the way. Turning it off puts every setting back. Asks for your password once.
ui.gameMode.leftOn: Game Mode was left on. Turn it off?
ui.history.deleteConfirm: Delete every saved check and session? This can't be undone.
ui.history.empty: No checks yet. Your checks and game sessions appear here.
ui.live.off: Turn on Game Mode to watch the connection while you play.
ui.live.title: Live
ui.settings.privacy: Nothing leaves your Mac except the test traffic to the speed-test and latency servers. No accounts, no analytics.
ui.settings.speed: Include a speed test in each check
ui.settings.speed.help: It fills your whole internet line for about 20 seconds.
ui.settings.why: Cloud gaming lags for many reasons: the Mac's own Wi-Fi, the household line, or the game's servers. Game Ready tells you which one, before you start and while you play.
ui.xcloud.applied: Tuned for this session. Your own settings come back when Game Mode goes off.
ui.xcloud.differs: Not tuned yet. Turn on "Game Mode also tunes Better xCloud" in Settings, or change it yourself.
ui.xcloud.failed: Couldn't change Better xCloud's settings. Nothing was left half-changed.
ui.xcloud.jsDisabled: The browser blocks this. In Chrome or Edge: View → Developer → Allow JavaScript from Apple Events. In Safari: Develop → Allow JavaScript from Apple Events.
ui.xcloud.matches: Already set: highest bitrate, high profile, Prefer IPv6.
ui.xcloud.noTab: Open xbox.com in the browser so Game Ready can read Better xCloud's settings.
ui.xcloud.notAllowed: macOS didn't allow Game Ready to control the browser. Turn it on in System Settings → Privacy & Security → Automation.
ui.xcloud.notInstalled: Better xCloud isn't installed in this browser, or hasn't saved any settings yet.
ui.xcloud.restorePending: Your Better xCloud settings will be put back next time xbox.com is open.
ui.xcloud.tune: Game Mode also tunes Better xCloud
ui.xcloud.tune.help: Sets the highest bitrate, the high H.264 profile and Prefer IPv6, and puts your own settings back when Game Mode goes off. Needs an open xbox.com tab and, in the browser, Allow JavaScript from Apple Events.
ui.xcloud.unknown: Not read yet. Open xbox.com and press Refresh.
verdict.incomplete.subtitle: Part of the check didn't run. Try again.
verdict.incomplete.title: Couldn't finish the check
verdict.none.subtitle: About a minute. It tests your Mac, Wi-Fi and internet.
verdict.none.title: Check before you play
verdict.notReady.subtitle: Something will cause lag. See why below.
verdict.notReady.title: Not ready
verdict.ready.subtitle: Everything looks good.
verdict.ready.title: Ready to play
verdict.warning.subtitle: You can play. One thing could be better.
verdict.warning.title: Ready, with a warning
